summary: Python terminal validator for plan acceptance; canonical completion receipt published under repair/round-1 with deterministic successor on content conflict; candidate binding hashes HEAD, tracked diff, and non-generated untracked files; generated paths excluded by explicit rules; slices R0-R4 map to registered test selectors and green command IDs; full run requires all slices, resume state, non-authorizing terminal receipts, bindings, and validation; required bindings include contract, registry, authority manifest, knowledge context/freeze, and ready non-authorizing skill-input receipt targeting the plan; maintainer authorization must match plan ID, transition, paths, and hashes; knowledge failures tolerate catalog_stale only with successor refresh; authority accepts implementation-authorized or implementation-complete states with matching authorizations; commands run only from repository-contained working directories; result records hashes, selectors, failures, and no authorization; full pass emits implementation-complete receipt; missing directories, invalid JSON, unknown slices, command failures, hash drift, or lifecycle violations fail.
